A '''battle''' occurred at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in the [[Imperial Skirmishes]], a desperate attempt by the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] and the [[replacement warlord]]s to turn the tide in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
